summary: lightclient 提交 EIP-8141 修改，允许任意签名数据，避免自定义验证器使用规范签名哈希时的循环依赖。nerolation 把 EIP-7928（BAL）中 7702 委托的跟踪方式回退到“方案一”：在预热之后检查，解析时读取委托目标，相关访问都保留在 BAL 中；EIP-8279 列入 Hegotá PFI 并合并。ChainSecurity 公布对 CoW Protocol 求解器所用 EIP-7702 委托合约的审计。tcoratger 表示将评估 Flock 能否用于证明以太坊后量子签名聚合。

summary_en: lightclient submitted an EIP-8141 change allowing arbitrary signature data, avoiding a circular dependency when custom verifiers use the canonical signing hash. nerolation reverted the 7702 delegation tracking in EIP-7928 (BAL) back to "option 1": checks happen after warming, the delegate is read during resolution, and those accesses all stay in the BAL; EIP-8279 was listed as Hegotá PFI and merged. ChainSecurity published its audit of the EIP-7702 delegation contract used by CoW Protocol solvers. tcoratger said the team will evaluate whether Flock suits proving Ethereum's post-quantum signature aggregation.
